summary: Sentient Brands Holdings filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026 disclosing a Verified Complaint filed October 2, 2026 in Nevada's Eighth Judicial District Court (Clark County), captioned Sentient Brands Holdings, Inc. v. John Doukas, et al. Defendants include an individual alleged to have exercised substantial influence over corporate affairs, affiliated entities, former officers, consultants and service providers, plus certain registered holders; Empire Stock Transfer is named solely as nominal defendant for stock-ledger relief. Board authorized filing September 27, 2026. The action seeks declaratory and equitable relief plus recovery of corporate property tied to challenged 2020-2025 issuances, compensation and debt conversions, continuing the Compliance and Restitution initiative. Watch for share-surrender or cancellation mechanics and any ledger corrections affecting float.
